title: Efficacy Study in Patients With Acne Vulgaris.
brief_summary: Safety and efficacy study in patients with acne vulgaris
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy male or non pregnant female aged ≥ 9 years with a clinical diagnosis of acne vulgaris

Exclusion Criteria:

* Female Subjects who are pregnant, nursing or planning to become pregnant during study participation.
